## 리얼아머
### 0.1.7 Change Log
#### Forge 1.20.1
##### Added
* Added armor support for zombies, skeletons, piglins and other armor-wearing mobs, plus horses.
#### Fabric / NeoForge 1.21.1
##### Added
* Added armor support for zombies, skeletons, piglins and other armor-wearing mobs, plus horses and wolves.
#### Fabric / NeoForge 26.3
##### Added
* Added armor support for zombies, skeletons, piglins and other armor-wearing mobs, plus horses, zombie horses, wolves, nautiluses and zombie nautiluses.
